selection_ranking: currently fitting all visible GPUs only; rank by already observed min/max free-memory ratio over recent6 admission/resource snapshots, then historical floor and currentfree. Ranking only: a sole current fit is admitted regardless of history. No waiting, fixed index, utilization or foreign-process exclusion.
own_cache_reclaim: after initialization and on low reserve: release only unused own PyTorch cache; allocated tensor values unchanged and dev body bit parity checked. If reserve remains low10seconds exit own process.
